notes: Every entry was opened on the retrieved date and its content checked. Add a new entry only after opening the link yourself. Types: support = manufacturer troubleshooting page (safe checks), service = manufacturer repair or booking page, info = background page that is not a how-to, guide = DIY teardown guide (advanced, never shown when a safety stop applies). Brand names are matched case-insensitively; Redmi, Poco and Mi count as Xiaomi.

entries.title: If your iPhone or iPod touch won't charge
entries.note: Middle East version of the page. Swap for a Sri Lanka version if one exists.
entries.verified_note: Steps: try another cable and outlet, restart, clear port debris, force restart, then get service. Does not tell the user to open the phone.

entries.title: Apple Service and Repair for iPhone Battery
entries.note: Booking options (in person or by mail) depend on country. The cost estimate tool did not load when checked.
entries.verified_note: Offers troubleshooting, service options and warranty coverage info.

entries.title: Apple Service and Repair for iPhone Screens
entries.note: Albania version of the page. Options depend on country.
entries.verified_note: Online troubleshooting, Apple Authorized Service Provider, repair status.

entries.title: If your iPhone or iPad gets too hot or too cold
entries.verified_note: Power off, move somewhere cooler away from sunlight, let it cool fully.

entries.title: Water and other liquid damage to iPhone isn't covered by warranty
entries.note: Explains liquid contact indicators and warranty. It does not give drying steps.
entries.verified_note: Says to contact Apple or an authorised provider for inspection if unsure.

entries.title: iPhone 13 Screen Replacement (iFixit)
entries.note: Advanced repair: opens the phone, uses heat and cuts adhesive. A technician is the safer choice.
entries.verified_note: Opened. Moderate, 1 to 2 hours. Involves opening the phone, applying heat and separating adhesive.

entries.title: What to do if your Galaxy phone is not charging
entries.note: United Arab Emirates version of the page.
entries.verified_note: Check charger and cable, clean port, soft reboot, update, Safe Mode, Samsung Members diagnostics. No opening of the phone.

entries.title: What to do when your phone heats up
entries.note: United Arab Emirates version of the page.
entries.verified_note: Rest the phone, turn off radios, close apps, lower brightness, remove the case, unplug the charger.

entries.title: What to do when your Samsung Galaxy device appears to be slow or unresponsive
entries.note: United Arab Emirates version of the page.
entries.verified_note: Install updates, close background apps, reboot, run Phone diagnostics.

entries.title: What to do when your Samsung Galaxy device battery drains faster
entries.note: Software checks only. It says the battery is a consumable part and lost capacity cannot be restored.
entries.verified_note: Turn off unused features, Device care, sleeping apps, power saving, uninstall draining apps, battery diagnostics.

entries.title: Samsung Galaxy A51 Screen Replacement (iFixit)
entries.note: Advanced repair: opens the phone, uses heat and cuts adhesive. The link host is proxy.ifixit.com, so check the www.ifixit.com version opens too.
entries.verified_note: Opened. Moderate, 1 to 2 hours. Involves opening the phone, heat and cutting adhesive.

entries.title: Fix a Pixel phone that won't charge or turn on
entries.verified_note: Check charger, cable and outlet, charge for 10 minutes, reset manually, contact support. No opening of the phone.

entries.title: Help keep your Pixel phone from feeling too warm or hot
entries.verified_note: Check device temperature, pause heavy apps, lower brightness, unplug and cool down.

entries.title: Get your device repaired (Pixel Phone Help)
entries.note: Options depend on device, warranty and country. Availability in Sri Lanka has not been confirmed.
entries.verified_note: Walk-in or mail-in repair for cracked screens and phones that won't charge. Does not mention battery replacement.

entries.title: Google Pixel 8a Screen Replacement (iFixit)
entries.note: Advanced repair: opens the phone, uses heat and replaces adhesive. This is the Turkish iFixit site, so the page text may be in Turkish.
entries.verified_note: Opened. Medium, 1 to 2 hours. Involves opening the phone, heat (hair dryer, heat gun or hot plate) and replacing adhesive.

entries.title: Why can't the REDMI 13 charge?
entries.note: Written for the REDMI 13, not the Note 13. The checks are general.
entries.verified_note: Check adapter and cable, let the phone cool, dry the USB port, update, restart, then contact after-sales.

entries.title: How to do if mobile phone overheat when playing games, charging, watching movies?
entries.note: Mostly explains why phones warm up. For serious overheating it says to visit an authorized after-sales center.

entries.title: The REDMI Note 13 Pro consumes power quickly
entries.note: Written for the Note 13 Pro. It only covers display settings (dark mode, auto brightness, refresh rate).
